question: Seven boxes are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. S is fifth from the top. Only two boxes are kept between S and V. R is kept just below V. Only two boxes are kept between P and T. P is placed in one of the positions above T. Only one box is kept between S and Q. Which box is kept fourth from the bottom?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

1) S is fifth from the top.

2) Only two boxes are kept between S and V.

3) R is kept just below V.

4) Only one box is kept between S and Q.

5) Only two boxes are kept between P and T. 

6) P is placed in one of the positions above T.

And, U will placed at the remaining box.

So, box 'T' is kept fourth from the bottom.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
